kurals.tr: Karumaththaal Naanudhal Naanun Thirunudhal / Nallavar Naanup Pira
kurals.m: True modesty is the fear of (evil) deeds; all other modesty is (simply) the bashfulness of virtuous maids

kurals.tr: Oonutai Echcham Uyirkkellaam Veralla / Naanutaimai Maandhar Sirappu
kurals.m: Food, clothing and the like are common to all men but modesty is peculiar to the good

kurals.tr: Oonaik Kuriththa Uyirellaam Naanennum / Nanmai Kuriththadhu Saalpu
kurals.m: As the body is the abode of the spirit, so the excellence of modesty is the abode of perfection

kurals.tr: Aniandro Naanutaimai Saandrorkku Aqdhindrel / Piniandro Peetu Natai
kurals.m: Is not the modesty ornament of the noble ? Without it, their haughtiness would be a pain (to others)

kurals.tr: Pirarpazhiyum Thampazhiyum Naanuvaar Naanukku / Uraipadhi Ennum Ulaku
kurals.m: The world regards as the abode of modesty him who fear his own and other's guilt

kurals.tr: Naanveli Kollaadhu Manno Viyangnaalam / Penalar Melaa Yavar
kurals.m: The great make modesty their barrier (of defence) and not the wide world

kurals.tr: Naanaal Uyiraith Thurappar Uyirpporuttaal / Naandhuravaar Naanaal Pavar
kurals.m: The modest would rather lose their life for the sake of modesty than lose modesty for the sake of life

kurals.tr: Pirarnaanath Thakkadhu Thaannaanaa Naayin / Aramnaanath Thakkadhu Utaiththu
kurals.m: Virtue is likely to forsake him who shamelessly does what others are ashamed of

kurals.tr: Kulanjutum Kolkai Pizhaippin Nalanjutum / Naaninmai Nindrak Katai
kurals.m: Want of manners injures one's family; but want of modesty injures one's character

kurals.tr: Naanakath Thillaar Iyakkam Marappaavai / Naanaal Uyirmarutti Atru
kurals.m: The actions of those who are without modesty at heart are like those of puppet moved by a string
